scope: derived compact evidence; evaluator fields never sent to model; raw images and full inputs remain local

initial_plan.goal_evidence: The target red sphere is visible in the forward view, with a depth estimate of 5.5 meters. This indicates it is a distant target on the forward path.
initial_plan.tentative_route: Move forward along the central path toward the target. The terrain looks mostly open and clear ahead.
initial_plan.occlusion_hypothesis: No nearby occluding objects are visible, so the target should remain visible until reached or blocked by terrain.
initial_plan.uncertainty: High. The depth estimate has some error, and the terrain may become obstructed or change slope. The target remains visible, which is encouraging, but the scene has no scale reference.
initial_plan.revision_trigger: If the target becomes occluded or the terrain changes unexpectedly, or if the target appears to be moving or the robot reaches a new area with different features.

result.arrival_endpoint: automatic 3 consecutive evaluator samples; separate from VLM STOP
